title: SermonPrepSupportInput
description: Input schema for generating sermon preparation and exegetical study notes.

passage.description: The biblical reference (e.g., Romans 8:28-39 or Exodus 3:1-15).

translation.description: Preferred Bible translation (e.g., ESV, NIV, CSB, NASB, NLT, KJV).

theological_tradition.description: Theological framework (e.g., Reformed, Wesleyan, Baptist, Anglican, Pentecostal, Evangelical).

series_theme.description: Optional overarching sermon series title or core theme.

audience_context.description: Target audience (e.g., Multi-generational suburban church, college students, unchurched seekers, mature believers).

pastor_initial_notes.description: Any preliminary insights, sermon title ideas, or specific angles the pastor already has in mind.
